description.text:
League Challenges were small tournaments that a store running a Pokémon League could hold once a month. Each came with a sealed kit of twelve stamped cards, three for each place, for the top four players in each age division; every copy carries the Pokémon League logo and a 1st, 2nd, 3rd or 4th Place stamp.

The first League Challenge cards, from the first events in 2013 until BREAKthrough in 2015, were crosshatch holofoil prints, beginning with Dark Explorers' Scyther for the 2013-2014 Chespin and Fennekin League seasons. From BREAKthrough's Marowak on they were reverse holo, apart from a holofoil Mew from Evolutions, up to Sword & Shield's Frosmoth.
